note: Outside the slice, a column owner guarded by its complete originals is checked against them and resolves as a deferred reference; it stands for every [[identity.column_owner]] form.
fails_if: `compile_deferred_partitions` checks the outside-slice owner's `expected_records`/digest against the projected partition family instead of the complete originals, so the guarded ANSWER owner goes stale and the edge to `scb/sample/amount` is no longer a deferred reference
